A little clarity

Questions, answered.

Have a question about your own situation? Ask it directly.

Ask April

Buying and selling in Columbus, answered

Does April Johnson work with both buyers and sellers?

Yes. I represent buyers and sellers, including clients purchasing their first home, selling a property, relocating or exploring land and investment opportunities.

Can one agent help me compare Columbus and Phenix City?

I am licensed in Georgia and Alabama and serve both areas. Tell me your preferred locations and property requirements so we can discuss the search.

Where do I start if I need to buy and sell?

Start with a conversation about the property you own, your next purchase and your timing. We can identify which decisions need attention first.

Does April help with moves to Fort Benning?

Yes. Military relocation is part of my practice. I am a U.S. Army veteran and hold the Military Relocation Professional certification.

Can I ask questions before deciding to move?

Yes. Tell me what you are considering and what you need to understand before taking the next step.

You don’t need every answer before you call.

Tell April whether you’re buying, selling or both, and when you’d like to move. She’ll reply personally with the next step.
